name: MW
quote: Other sites say $20–25 but then after you fill in their form and give your info, you find out they charge you $35 to print the certificate. Here the price was clear upfront and included the certificate. Customer service is very good — I typed my email wrong when I signed up, I called them, and they fixed it right away, and it was during the weekend.
